meta.title: Fix Python test timeouts in full matrix CI workflow
meta.body_summary: Increase CI job timeouts for Python tests in full matrix from 60 to 90 minutes, add per-test timeouts using pytest-timeout, and clean up client timeout configs.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed CI timeouts by increasing workflow timeout, then per-test timeouts, and final combination; reviewers guided away from irrelevant client timeout changes, leading to merge after ~3 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1795 changed lines, this is a medium-to-large edit by absolute volume, but most churn comes from a merge-main commit bringing in unrelated changes (csharp, etc.). The performance fix itself spans a few files in .github, python/tests, and utils, totaling about 50 lines directly related. This is a small CI improvement, consistent with a performance PR that merged after iterative review.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer Yury-Fridlyand opposed increasing workflow timeout and demanded per-test timeouts; after Copilot implemented per-test, maintainer avifenesh requested adding both, resulting in final combined approach.
review_details.performance_claim: Reducing CI failures by increasing workflow timeout to 90 minutes and adding per-test 300s timeout to prevent hanging.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent had to navigate conflicting maintainer preferences (increase workflow timeout vs per-test) and iteratively adjust with 3 cycles of feedback; merge required satisfying both maintainers and removing irrelevant configuration changes.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed YAML and Python test config; Yury-Fridlyand pointed out Java client per-test pattern.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No CI run metrics provided; only narrative claims and maintainer acceptance based on past failures.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Copilot reverted irrelevant client timeout changes and iteratively adjusted timeout strategy within the PR; no new regressions introduced.

core_change_summary.description: Increased CI job timeout for Python test jobs from 60 to 90 minutes in .github/workflows/python.yml; added pytest-timeout plugin with 300s per-test timeout in pytest.ini and dev_requirements.txt; originally included client timeout constants in conftest.py but removed after review; fixed error message formatting in utils/cluster_manager.py.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Conftest.py changes were reverted; cluster_manager.py fix is incidental.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: increased workflow timeout and added client timeout constants.
avifenesh questioned client timeout relevance; Copilot removed those changes.
Yury-Fridlyand requested per-test timeouts instead of workflow increase; Copilot implemented per-test timeouts with pytest-timeout.
avifenesh asked for both per-test and workflow timeout; Copilot combined them.
Merge commit brought in main; merged after ~73 hours.

review_signals.summary: Questioned relevance of client timeout changes in conftest.py, noting the issue is whole workflow timing out.
Suggested not to increase workflow timeout, but add per-test timeouts like Java client.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot implemented per-test timeouts with pytest-timeout.

review_signals.summary: After per-test timeout implementation, requested adding both per-test and increased workflow timeout.
Acknowledged each review comment and described the changes applied.
Approved the PR without inline comments.
